summary: Session 3 of 3 (final): the Configurator handoff record for set 005 (clef configurability). Documentation only - no engine code changed. Wrote docs/session-sets/005-clef-configurability/configurator-handoff.md, the engine-side mirror of the Configurator's 009-custom-clefs/s1-engine-coordination.md: it enumerates the full landed engine contract - every new cnb: clef setting with exact name/type/default/semantics and config.ly line (cnb:clef-style :121, cnb:clef-text :127, cnb:clef-size-semitones :144, cnb:clef-name :150, cnb:clef-gutter-semitones :162), the cnb:register-clef! name def two-argument signature (the recorded deviation from the backlog's proposed single-list '(name path-data)), the definition alist fields (required path in the notehead command-list format + float anchor-semitones, optional height-semitones and color), the size/gutter precedence, the cache-key rework, and the anchor contract as implemented (anchor-semitones = FLOAT semitone of the glyph's TOP edge on the notehead engraver's middle-C=0 pitch axis; placement reuses the notehead position formula via cnb:clef-anchor-y-offset). Cross-checked against the moved Configurator repo (d:/Projects/chromatic-notation-configurator, set 009 - NOT the stale source/repos path) via a read-only subagent: produced a field-mapping table (enabled:false -> 'none, kind:glyph -> 'custom, kind:text -> 'text, dozenal = engine-native default with no Configurator kind) and, per the spec's flag-mismatches-explicitly rule, six labelled reconciliation flags for the Configurator author: (A) anchorSemi origin - the Configurator defines it only in its internal semitone grid, so the exporter must emit on the middle-C=0 axis; (B) gutter divergence - Configurator gutter.paddingH is pixels applied both sides vs the engine's cnb:clef-gutter-semitones in semitones on the right edge only; (C) path format - the engine consumes only the lilypondPath command-list format (never raw svgPath) and self-measures the extent so naturalHeight/viewBox need not be exported; (D) text color/font - reproduce via a markup cnb:clef-text, not a bare string; (E) no 'standard native-glyph escape hatch requested or added (consistent); (F) no preview-vs-engine placement divergence analogous to the keysig tonicOctave case. Marked backlog items 1.1-1.4 resolved in docs/planning/configurator-coordination-backlog.md (RESOLVED header banner + scheduling-table checkmark + new section-5 subsection enumerating the four deliverables, a pointer to configurator-handoff.md, and the still-owed Configurator-side follow-ons: lift the exports-nothing pin, LY export-spec addendum, emit-if-changed exporter lines). Per the cross-repo rule of engagement, docs/CNB-LY-EXPORT-SPEC-v1_2.md was NOT bumped here (the addendum is synced Configurator-side later, as 1.2.1 was for set 004). Final verification (spec step 3): re-ran the FULL suites once more - unit 254/254, integration 245/245 (343 assertions, 9 specs) including both golden joy-to-the-world specs; git status shows zero modified golden SVGs/harvests, so the baseline is byte-stable with default settings. Note: docs/planning/ was untracked in git before this session; the backlog file was newly added to tracking to satisfy the spec's commit step. Deliverable commit 9377949.
